text.p: Continental Information Systems Corp said Friday it appointed Michael Rosen, a director of the company, as president and chief executive.
The company also named Jonah Meer chief operating officer and chief financial officer.
Rosen is chief executive of Oscar Gruss & Son Inc, a broker-dealer in New York and is to remain in that post, the company said. Oscar Gruss is a major Continental shareholder.
The former president and chief executive, Thomas Prinzing, has returned to running the company's aircraft subsidiary, CIS Air Group, on a full-time basis.
The company could not immediately be reached for comment.
